title: Evaluation of a single gate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $o$ be either conjunction or disjunction, let $l_1,l_2\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be signed input literals, and let $x$ be a Boolean assignment to the $n$ inputs. The program consisting of the single gate $o$ applied to $l_1,l_2$ evaluates to $o$ applied to the truth values of the literals: the value at index $l_i$ agrees with the sign of $l_i$ for each $i=1,2$.
hypotheses_covered: $l_1$ and $l_2$ are input indices paired with Boolean signs
$x$ is a Boolean assignment to the $n$ inputs
